scope_honesty.statement: The strict write contract is currently UNPROVEN on this repo, not proven working. Every write in this run targeted an allowlisted path, so the PreToolUse refusal path never ran. .hook-logs/hook.jsonl contains only 4 mcp_tool_postuse telemetry events (matching the 4 dispatches) and carries no write-decision entries. Confidence that only the 3 allowlisted paths changed rests on git status, not on any hook log. This is a negative result about the plugin's own safety machinery: absence of a refusal is not evidence that the gate would refuse.
No dependency delta exists, so npm audit would surface only pre-existing repo-wide advisories unactionable from this run. The repo's dependency posture is unassessed by this review, not clean.

container.querySelector('svg') is truthy on every getColumnIcon branch. The test proves an icon renders, not that the correct icon renders. Accepted as proportionate; the test name says 'an icon' and does not overclaim.

auth_mode=estimated: direct-tier costs are char-heuristic estimates. Three were corrected upward using subagent-reported totals after the heuristic understated per-turn context re-send. Mechanical-tier costs are vendor-reported.
